name: The City of Black and Graey
source:
You find yourself in a grey city and talk to the black citizen to find a way back home and possibly to understand what's going on.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23446]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己身处一个灰色的城市，并与黑人公民交谈以找到回家的路，并可能了解正在发生的事情。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23446]引理软论坛[/url]]
